title: Relics Of The Guide
description: The Relics Of The Guide adds items from terraria to help you on your journey.
body:
# Relics of the Guide

> *"The Guide would like to remind you that some things are worth carrying."*

Relics of the Guide brings loved and useful items from Terraria to Minecraft! 

---

## Items

### Recall Potion
Teleports you to your spawn point. If your bed or respawn anchor has been destroyed, you'll be sent to the world spawn instead.

- Found in village chests and other structures

### Magic Mirror
A non-consumable variation of the Recall Potion

- Found in Chests and structures underground

### Hermes Boots
Significantly increases your movement speed while equipped in an accessory slot. Like a permenant Speed II potion.

- Found in Chests and structures underground


### Soul of Flight
A rare crafting material dropped by flying creatures. Used to craft wings.

- Dropped rarely by common flying mobs like bees and bats
- Dropped uncommonly by vexxes, allays, phantoms
- Multiple drop from the Ender Dragon and the Wither

### Wings
Grants the ability to fly. Hold jump while airborne to ascend, release to fall naturally. When flight time runs out, glide slowly to safety. And removes all fall damage.

- Angel Wings crafted with Breeze Rods
- Demon Wings crafted with Blaze Rods

---

## Purpose

Relics of the Guide simply make minecraft just a bit better. currently improving the exploration side of minecraft by giving you valuable items for going in daring places.

And if you ever get lost, you can just teleport back home!

Plus the wings allow for you to traverse vertically with no problems.

---

## Dependencies

[Curios API](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) - version 9.5.1 or later
Minecraft NeoForge 1.21.1

---

## Planned Content

- More mobility accessories such as Shiny Red Balloon and Lucky Horseshoe
- Full Terraspark Boots crafting tree
- Additional wing tiers
- Combat accessories
